info.title: OpenAPI-to-Go Generator Test Cases
info.description: A collection of atomic OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Objects representing different structural variations and data types to thoroughly test a Go struct generator.

OneOfObjectsWithoutDiscriminator.description: Tests handling of oneOf where the possible options are either a simple primitive string or a complex referenced object, without an explicit discriminator. This requires the Go parser to try-unmarshal in order or inspect the type.

assigned_to.description: The assignee, which can be either a plain string username or a full SimpleUser object.
